results.label: thm:extraction
results.statement: A large r-tree-packed graph has an almost-r tree packing with every selected edge of low shortcut resistance.
conditions: r sufficiently large;loss r^-1/16,cut-feasible full SPD X>=LH+I/n;R_X(e)<=4r^-1/2;finite-cover/Brouwer selection has no uniform running-time bound.
constants_and_constructions: r sufficiently large;loss r^-1/16,cut-feasible full SPD X>=LH+I/n;R_X(e)<=4r^-1/2;finite-cover/Brouwer selection has no uniform running-time bound.

results.label: lem:response
results.statement: One shortcut response controls almost all crossing edges simultaneously along a nested partition chain.
conditions: All parts locally q-tree-packable;dyadic crossing-count bins and tail4;bad fraction r^-1/4;not arbitrary unrelated partitions.
constants_and_constructions: All parts locally q-tree-packable;dyadic crossing-count bins and tail4;bad fraction r^-1/4;not arbitrary unrelated partitions.

results.label: thm:fixedpoint
results.statement: A continuous self-map of a finite-dimensional compact convex set has a fixed point.
conditions: Nonempty compact convex set;Sperner/subdivision/nearest projection proof;no iteration-rate guarantee.
constants_and_constructions: Nonempty compact convex set;Sperner/subdivision/nearest projection proof;no iteration-rate guarantee.

results.label: lemma:sperner
results.statement: A properly boundary-labelled triangulated simplex has an odd number of fully labelled top simplices.
conditions: Finite triangulation and exact Sperner boundary condition;parity count,not a polynomial search guarantee.
constants_and_constructions: Finite triangulation and exact Sperner boundary condition;parity count,not a polynomial search guarantee.

results.label: thm:hierarchy-power
results.statement: Hierarchy-average marked-edge resistance is at most q^-31/40 for an admissible shortcut.
conditions: q>=absolute qH;node-induced q connectivity,marked O>=parent-boundary/q,each edge in at most two parent boundaries;D full SPD,cut upper bound only.
constants_and_constructions: q>=absolute qH;node-induced q connectivity,marked O>=parent-boundary/q,each edge in at most two parent boundaries;D full SPD,cut upper bound only.

results.label: prop:hierarchy-assigned
results.statement: Geometrically separated assigned bags admit a dimension-free edge-length energy bound.
conditions: Assignment >=24C3/k,distinct owners,lambda scale separation,exact center/witness restrictions and induced local connectivity;C3=10000,C4=3 in final use.
constants_and_constructions: Assignment >=24C3/k,distinct owners,lambda scale separation,exact center/witness restrictions and induced local connectivity;C3=10000,C4=3 in final use.

results.label: ha:construction
results.statement: A labelled annulus collection can be updated while retaining disjoint valid charged edge portions and token budget.
conditions: Four invariants L1-L4,three insertion operations and positive-part width tokens;different owners may overlap geometrically only with disjoint conflict domains.
constants_and_constructions: Four invariants L1-L4,three insertion operations and positive-part width tokens;different owners may overlap geometrically only with disjoint conflict domains.

results.label: ha:ancestor
results.statement: An already live annulus meeting a new bag has ancestor-compatible owner geometry.
conditions: Process phases in decreasing radius and bags in increasing depth;conflict-domain exclusions required.
constants_and_constructions: Process phases in decreasing radius and bags in increasing depth;conflict-domain exclusions required.

results.label: ha:unique-interior
results.statement: Interior classification of a new bag is unique among eligible old annuli.
conditions: Exact shell supports and disjoint conflict domains;ordinary centers remain included.
constants_and_constructions: Exact shell supports and disjoint conflict domains;ordinary centers remain included.

results.label: ha:heredity
results.statement: Concentric restriction inherits validity when routing and witness conditions are retained.
conditions: Inner labels and outer-boundary endpoints are checked separately;arbitrary geometric shrinking alone is insufficient.
constants_and_constructions: Inner labels and outer-boundary endpoints are checked separately;arbitrary geometric shrinking alone is insufficient.

results.label: ha:border-monotone
results.statement: A bag classified on a border cannot later become interior in the permitted update order.
conditions: Uses expanded-interval treatment and radius/depth order,not arbitrary rearrangement.
constants_and_constructions: Uses expanded-interval treatment and radius/depth order,not arbitrary rearrangement.

results.label: ha:shrink-cost
results.statement: Annulus side shrinking has a controlled token deficit repaid by newly inserted border bags.
conditions: Positive parts included;extra-credit and shrink branches separate;reserve C4 and shrink C3+1;deficit<=half new bag mass.
constants_and_constructions: Positive parts included;extra-credit and shrink branches separate;reserve C4 and shrink C3+1;deficit<=half new bag mass.

results.label: ha:edge-paths
results.statement: A local cut lower bound supplies the required number of edge-disjoint paths.
conditions: Integral antisymmetric flow and augmentations;graph labels/parallel edges retained,induced owner graph after exclusions.
constants_and_constructions: Integral antisymmetric flow and augmentations;graph labels/parallel edges retained,induced owner graph after exclusions.

results.label: ha:pruning
results.statement: Predecessor deletion removes at most a controlled fraction of assigned bag mass.
conditions: Per predecessor charge <=4 delta
constants_and_constructions: Per predecessor charge <=4 delta

results.label: ha:labeled-energy
results.statement: A valid labelled annulus family charges at most total original graph edge length.
conditions: Charges are disjoint edge portions,not entire paths;both endpoints and prefix exits obey exclusions;zero-length edges contribute zero.
constants_and_constructions: Charges are disjoint edge portions,not entire paths;both endpoints and prefix exits obey exclusions;zero-length edges contribute zero.

results.label: ha:insertable-arrangement
results.statement: Pruned assigned bags retain at least half the input mass in an insertable arrangement.
conditions: Small predecessor boundary and exact distinct-owner conditions;weak/noninsertable mass charged before construction.
constants_and_constructions: Small predecessor boundary and exact distinct-owner conditions;weak/noninsertable mass charged before construction.

results.label: ha:input-valid
results.statement: The surviving initial ordinary balls satisfy the routing/geometry invariants.
conditions: Witness short parent edges,large bags,local edge connectivity;intersection in continuous cube,not only sampled vertex images.
constants_and_constructions: Witness short parent edges,large bags,local edge connectivity;intersection in continuous cube,not only sampled vertex images.

results.label: hb:bucketing
results.statement: Two truncations select homogeneous bad-edge distance scales with explicit logarithmic loss.
conditions: Bad squared average>=alpha average distance;J=1+ceil(log2(256/alpha^2));gamma>=1/(4J^4).
constants_and_constructions: Bad squared average>=alpha average distance;J=1+ceil(log2(256/alpha^2));gamma>=1/(4J^4).

results.label: hb:homogeneous-bags
results.statement: A homogeneous collection yields many disjoint balls or large assigned bags with controlled scale range.
conditions: Retained density s=alpha gamma/32;local connectivity and assignment bounds remain necessary.
constants_and_constructions: Retained density s=alpha gamma/32;local connectivity and assignment bounds remain necessary.

results.label: prop:hierarchy-bags
results.statement: Bad marked-edge mass produces a multiscale compact/assigned bag family.
conditions: epsilon<1/3,beta>=36,smallness s^epsilon<=1/(48 beta C1);capture loss384 beta C1 C2 L H,not dependent on hierarchy depth.
constants_and_constructions: epsilon<1/3,beta>=36,smallness s^epsilon<=1/(48 beta C1);capture loss384 beta C1 C2 L H,not dependent on hierarchy depth.

results.label: hb:spectral-packing
results.statement: A positive projected spectral numerator supplies well-separated Euclidean vertex balls.
conditions: Upsilon>0,a>0;rank-approximation argument with explicit tail and b>=2;Upsilon=0 cannot imply positive separated balls.
constants_and_constructions: Upsilon>0,a>0;rank-approximation argument with explicit tail and b>=2;Upsilon=0 cannot imply positive separated balls.

results.label: prop:hierarchy-compact
results.statement: Separated compact bags have total radius-mass bounded by graph edge L1 length times4/k.
conditions: k-connected graph,cube embedding,beta>=36,lambda<=1/12;finite or countable sequence via finite initial segments.
constants_and_constructions: k-connected graph,cube embedding,beta>=36,lambda<=1/12;finite or countable sequence via finite initial segments.

results.label: hc:length
results.statement: A witnessed hollow radial shell has cut-integral energy at least k times its width.
conditions: Both inner and outer vertex witnesses;strict shell versus center-inclusive ordinary ball;zero width discarded.
constants_and_constructions: Both inner and outer vertex witnesses;strict shell versus center-inclusive ordinary ball;zero width discarded.

results.label: lem:hierarchy-dual
